$comment: A worked cost/latency model for a capstone-shaped workflow.
PRICES ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are not quoted from any provider and will be wrong for
yours. Replace every number in `models` with your provider's current published rates
before you take any conclusion from this file — a cost model built on invented prices
is worse than no cost model, because it produces a confident number.
The SHAPE is the lesson: jobs x frequency x tokens x price, with cache and failure
retry accounted for. That shape transfers to any provider and any platform.
